messages.subject: Project Lyra — Licence mark-up (v2)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our mark-up is attached (tracked). The main moves are the ones we flagged: we've taken the royalty to 5.75%, extended the first-commercial-sale longstop from 30 to 36 months, and brought the liability cap down from 150% to 100%. Everything else is largely mechanical. Let's find time this week to talk the three commercial points through.

Oliver Jennings
Partner, Birchall Stone LLP
